 HoopsHype Oct. 28, 2026, 1:22 p.m. ET Indiana Pacers forward Pascal Siakam attended seminary school to fulfill his father’s wish to become a priest, before basketball led him down a different path. After becoming an NBA All-Star and champion, Siakam has used his platform to help the less fortunate — just as his late father hoped he would. “That’s the base. That’s who raised me to be the person I am and the man that I am,” Siakam recently told Andscape about his father. “I owe him everything. I want to continue to be impactful and help others.
